svg.title: sparse-dsa
svg.desc: DeepSeek Sparse Attention. A lightning indexer with 64 FP8 heads of 128 dims scores every past token: ReLU per head, then a weighted sum. The top 2,048 of 131,072 tokens (1.56%) are read by MQA-mode MLA, where 128 query heads share each 576-dim latent record (656 bytes in FP8). Multiply-accumulates per decode token per layer at 128K: dense MLA 18.3 G, indexer 1.07 G, sparse main attention 0.29 G; the indexer costs more than the main read once N exceeds 34,816. Training: 1,000-step indexer-only KL warm-up (2.1B tokens), then 15,000 sparse steps (943.7B tokens).

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: It,s = Σj=1 64 wt,j · ReLU(qI t,j · kI s )
